item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 09, 2026
item.description: The ripple effect is real right now! item.title: SEE IT: Tommy DeVito’s pregame Super Bowl outfit is a sight to behold
item.description: Tommy DeVito showed up to Super Bowl LX in style, sporting a fuzzy brown Columbia jacket and oversized sunglasses.

item.title: Dr. Oz urges Americans to get measles vaccine amid case surge
item.description: Dr. Mehmet Oz, administrator for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, urged Americans on Sunday to get vaccinated for measles as outbreaks spread across several U.S. states.

item.title: Julian Love, Seahawks defense dominate in Super Bowl win as Patriots QB Drake Maye struggles
item.description: Drake Maye committed three turnovers in the Patriots' 29-13 loss.

item.title: PHOTOS: Bad Bunny performs at the Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show
item.description: Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, also known as Bad Bunny, performs at the Apple Music Super Bowl LX Halftime Show at Levi's Stadium on February 8, 2026 in Santa Clara, California. Special guests included Lady Gaga and Ricky Martin.

item.title: Seahawks star Jaxon-Smith Njigba clears concussion protocol, returns to Super Bowl LX
item.description: Smith-Njigba had three receptions for 24 yards when he left the game.

item.title: Bad Bunny’s dance-party halftime show brings Lady Gaga, Ricky Martin
item.description: Fresh off last week’s historic Album of the Year Grammy win, Spanish-rapping Bad Bunny brought his singular stamp of joy to Levi’s Stadium during Super Bowl, starting in a sugar cane field, joined by Lada Gaga and Ricky Martin.

item.title: Seahawks’ Sam Darnold completes epic redemption arc with Super Bowl win over Patriots
item.description: Super Bowl LX won’t go down as the game of Sam Darnold’s life. But it will go down as the game that changed his life.
